provenance.note: The deposited asymmetric unit of entry 5SYF: one alpha-tubulin chain of 437 residues and one beta-tubulin chain of 426 residues, from Sus scrofa, reconstructed by cryo-electron microscopy at 3.5 Angstrom. Chapter 3 contact patches use protein heavy atoms within 4.5 Angstrom in 5SYF model 1; see repository docs/microtubule-contact-faces.md for partner operators, exact author residues and source digest.

chapters.title: One dimer
chapters.caption: Entry 5SYF, Taxol-stabilised cryo-EM at 3.5 Angstrom. Its asymmetric unit is one alpha-beta dimer, 6,818 atoms.

immersive.narration: Beta tubulin joins in amber. Alpha stays blue.

parts.label: Alpha tubulin
parts.note: Author chain A of 5SYF, residues 1-437: alpha tubulin, Sus scrofa. Residues 501 and 502 of the same author chain are its GTP and magnesium.

parts.label: Beta tubulin
parts.note: Author chain B of 5SYF, residues 1-436: beta tubulin, Sus scrofa. Residues 501 and 502 of the same author chain are its GDP and Taxol.

parts.label: GTP
parts.note: Author chain A residues 501 and 502: the deposited GTP and the magnesium ion beside it. Blue because they belong to alpha.

parts.label: GDP
parts.note: Author chain B residue 501: the deposited GDP. Amber because it belongs to beta.

parts.label: Taxol
parts.note: Author chain B residue 502, ligand TA1: the Taxol that stabilises this lattice. Amber because it belongs to beta.

chapters.title: Two halves
